description.narrative: Cash support to refugees in Türkiye to support their university studies.
Kontantstöd till flyktingar i Turkiet för att stödja deras universitetsstudier.

The intervention will support UNHCR Turkey's multi-year strategy 2023-2025 which has been updated to include 2026 and consists of five impact statements. The intervention will contribute to impact statement number three: Refugees participate in the social and economic life, harmoniously with the host community and the underlying objective Empowering communities and achieving gender equality. The related impact objective is "Refugees benefit from public education and training in an unhindered way" in the area of education. The intervention aims to provide support, through so-called Higher Education Cash Grants (HECG) to refugees studying at universities to help ensure that they are equipped with the skills necessary to achieve academic, social and professional success. By the end of the operation, 600 refugees will have gained access to higher education through HECG.
